name: product-discovery
description: Discover external customer problems and product requirements from human stakeholders. Assess customer evidence before investing, or map who to talk to, ask questions that surface hidden assumptions, detect gaps in real time, resolve conflicts, and translate conversations into structured SDD specs. Phase 0 upstream of Spec-Driven Development. Also grill a PRD, interrogate a proposal, poke holes in a spec, or interview its author about an existing draft, one consequential question at a time. Do not use for personal-life discovery (daily-life-discovery), general research without product requirements (research-methodology), or implementation planning.
